The '''Malastare 100''' was a [[Podracing/Legends|podracing]] track on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]] and the fifth race in the [[Amateur Podracing Circuit]] tournament. Its track favorite was [[Dud Bolt/Legends|Dud Bolt]].

==Other tracks of Malastare==
*[[Semipro Podracing Circuit|Semipro Circuit]] track: [[Dug Derby/Legends|Dug Derby]]
*[[Galactic Podracing Circuit/Legends|Galactic Circuit]] track: [[Sebulba's Legacy/Legends|Sebulba's Legacy]]

==Behind the scenes==
Malastare 100 bears a striking resemblance to the real-life speedway [[Wikipedia:Sonoma Raceway|Sonoma Raceway]].
